title: Pwani Logistics Fleet Management
overview: We developed a comprehensive web-based fleet management system for Pwani Logistics to track their trucks moving from the Port of Mombasa across East Africa in real-time.
overviewSecondary: The system includes GPS tracking integration, driver management, fuel consumption analytics, and automated maintenance alerts, drastically reducing their operational costs.
goalsText: The primary goal was to eliminate manual tracking and provide real-time visibility into the fleet's location and performance.
conclusionText: The project was a massive success, increasing Pwani Logistics' delivery efficiency by 30% and reducing fuel theft incidents through strict monitoring.

title: E-Pwani E-Commerce App
overview: Crackit designed and developed a native mobile application (iOS and Android) for E-Pwani, a rising e-commerce platform focusing on coastal vendors.
overviewSecondary: The app features a seamless checkout process, M-Pesa integration, vendor dashboards, and real-time order tracking.
goalsText: E-Pwani wanted to capture the mobile market and provide an easy-to-use platform for both buyers and local sellers.
conclusionText: Within 3 months of launch, E-Pwani saw a 50% increase in mobile sales and onboarded over 200 new coastal vendors onto the platform.

title: Mombasa Tourism Web Portal
overview: A beautifully designed, interactive web portal to showcase Mombasa's tourist attractions, allowing users to book tours, hotels, and experiences directly.
overviewSecondary: Built using Vue.js and a headless CMS, the site is lightning fast and highly optimized for SEO, ensuring global reach.
goalsText: To create a centralized, modern platform to boost tourism in Mombasa and provide a smooth booking experience for international and local tourists.
goalsBullets: Headless CMS for easy content updates.
conclusionText: The new portal increased online bookings by 45% and significantly improved the digital footprint of the Mombasa tourism sector.

title: Fintech Wallet Redesign
overview: Crackit was hired to completely overhaul the UI/UX of MobiPay's existing digital wallet application to improve user retention and simplify transactions.
overviewSecondary: We conducted extensive user research, simplified the user journey for sending money, and created a sleek, modern design system.
goalsText: MobiPay users were finding the old app clunky and confusing. The goal was a clean, intuitive, and trustworthy design.
goalsBullets: Creation of a new design system.
conclusionText: The redesign led to a 60% drop in user drop-offs during the transaction flow and overwhelmingly positive feedback from their user base.

title: AgriTech Supply Chain ERP
overview: We built a custom ERP system for Kilimo Coastal Network to manage their entire agricultural supply chain, from farmers to distributors.
overviewSecondary: The platform includes inventory management, payment processing, and advanced reporting dashboards to optimize the distribution of produce.
goalsText: To digitize the supply chain, reduce produce wastage, and ensure farmers get paid on time.
conclusionText: The ERP reduced supply chain inefficiencies by 40%, significantly lowering produce wastage and improving farmer satisfaction.

title: Healthcare Cloud Migration
overview: We successfully migrated Pwani MedCenter's legacy patient management system to a secure, HIPAA-compliant AWS cloud infrastructure.
overviewSecondary: Our DevOps team also set up automated backups, disaster recovery protocols, and CI/CD pipelines for their internal software updates.
goalsText: To move away from unreliable on-premise servers and ensure patient data is highly secure and accessible 24/7.
conclusionText: The hospital now experiences zero downtime, and their IT infrastructure costs have been reduced by 25% while vastly improving security.
